_about: THE ONE REGISTRY OF EVERY EXTERNAL SERVICE THE COMPANY DEPENDS ON (it_engineer, 24 Sep 2026, founder instruction 979 and its widening the same day). One entry per integration: the hosts it is reached on, the app_secrets keys and edge env it holds, how the IT engineer probes it and what it tries itself before telling the founder. A new integration is one entry here, not new code: probe.kind 'http' is run by _shared/integration_watch.ts as written; 'custom' names one of the few coded probes there; 'marketing' is measured by the marketing seat's own beat (founder rule 641: only that seat reads Meta and Postiz credentials); 'covered' names the existing duty that already owns it, so this registry never becomes a second owner. scripts/checks/every_external_host_and_secret_is_registered.test.mjs fails when code calls a host, or reads a secret or env name, that is in no entry, and (with a token) when production app_secrets holds a key no entry names. Placeholders: {secret:<app_secrets key>} and {env:<NAME>}.

stripe.what: payments: checkout, refunds, invoices, supplier charges
stripe.self_fix: retried once after 3 s; a refused key cannot be re-issued by the company
stripe.action: Issue a new secret key in the Stripe dashboard and store it as app_secrets.stripe_secret_key

stripe_test.what: Stripe test mode: the sandbox rehearsals pay with it
stripe_test.notify_why: test mode carries no customer money; the finding stays with the seats
stripe_test.action: Issue a new test secret key and store it as app_secrets.stripe_secret_key_test

stripe_webhook.what: Stripe tells stripe_webhook that a payment or refund happened
stripe_webhook.self_fix: a DISABLED endpoint that points at stripe_webhook is re-enabled through the Stripe API; the enabled-events wiring stays duty:payment's
stripe_webhook.action: Open the webhook in Stripe, check its failures and enable it

resend.what: every email the company sends, and the expenses inbox
resend.action: Open the sending domain in Resend: re-verify its DNS records, or issue a new API key and store it as app_secrets.resend_api_key

resend_webhooks.what: Resend posts delivery events to resend_webhook and inbound mail to resend_inbound

probe.by: resilience_ping deliveryCanary: a daily mail to Resend's bounce sink must come back through resend_webhook

resend_webhooks.action: Open Webhooks in Resend and check the endpoint is enabled

inbox_placement_seeds.what: the morning inbox placement check reads, read-only, which folder the day's seed invitation landed in: the founder's Gmail through the Gmail API (the Google client the YouTube connection already uses, plus its own gmail.readonly refresh token) and his Microsoft 365 mailbox through Microsoft Graph Mail.Read

probe.by: resilience_ping inboxPlacement: a mailbox that cannot be read by the window's start is verdict 'unread', which holds the batch and files deliverability:inbox_placement

inbox_placement_seeds.action: Store a Gmail refresh token (scope gmail.readonly) as app_secrets.gmail_seed_refresh_token and the Microsoft Graph app's tenant, client id and secret as ms_graph_tenant_id / ms_graph_client_id / ms_graph_client_secret

twilio.what: WhatsApp, SMS and the account every Twilio product bills to
twilio.action: Open the Twilio console: reactivate the account or issue a new API key (store twilio_api_key_sid and twilio_api_key_secret)

twilio_whatsapp_sender.what: the company's WhatsApp number as Meta sees it through Twilio
twilio_whatsapp_sender.self_fix: retried once after 3 s; a sender Meta took offline is re-registered only in the Twilio console
twilio_whatsapp_sender.action: Check the sender in the Twilio console. If Meta still shows the number connected, only Twilio can restore the sender's WABA link: open a Twilio support ticket and record it with fn_it_external_cause_open so you are not asked again

twilio_webhooks.what: Twilio posts inbound WhatsApp/SMS and delivery statuses to wa_inbound, sms_inbound and wa_status
twilio_webhooks.self_fix: none possible from here: Twilio could not reach our endpoint, so the endpoint or its URL is what is wrong
twilio_webhooks.action: Open the Twilio error log (codes 11200/11205: our webhook did not answer)

twilio_verify.what: sign-in codes by SMS and voice
twilio_verify.action: Open Verify services in the Twilio console and check the service exists

openrouter.what: the paid model gateway (on hold by the founder's ruling)
openrouter.notify_why: OpenRouter is on hold and the founder ruled it is never raised with him again; the finding stays with the seats
openrouter.action: Issue a new OpenRouter key and store it as app_secrets.openrouter_api_key

dropbox.what: the daily backups and the compliance archive
dropbox.self_fix: the probe IS the refresh: a new short-lived token is minted from the refresh token
dropbox.action: Reconnect the Dropbox app and store the new refresh token as app_secrets.dropbox_refresh_token

github.what: the repository, CI verdicts and signed-change reviews
github.action: Issue a new GitHub token with repo read scope and store it as app_secrets.github_token

probe.by: duty:live_code (fn_it_duties): the check-runs on main's head

vercel.self_fix: retried once after 3 s; deployments themselves are duty:live_code's
vercel.action: Issue a new Vercel token and store it as app_secrets.vercel_token

supabase.what: the database, auth, storage and every edge function
supabase.action: Open the Supabase status page and the project's dashboard

supabase_cron.what: the scheduled jobs and the 15-minute heartbeat

probe.by: resilience_ping: fn_cron_liveness pages platform_down; duty:heartbeat per failing step

probe._ok_why: measured 24 Sep 2026: the company's key carries task scopes only, so users/me answers 403 'Invalid scope(s)'; a refused or revoked key answers 401

cloudconvert.action: Issue a new CloudConvert API key and store it as app_secrets.cloudconvert_api_key

virustotal.action: Issue a new VirusTotal API key and store it as app_secrets.virustotal_api_key

sanctions_lists.what: the UN and UAE sanctions lists every party is screened against

postiz.what: publishing to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok

probe.by: marketing_channels integrationWatch, every beat: one finding per dead channel (refreshNeeded, disabled, inBetweenSteps, missing)

postiz.self_fix: none possible: a channel login is re-authorised only by a person in Postiz; its posts are held until then

meta.what: Facebook page and Instagram insights, ads, and the social inbox

probe.by: marketing_channels access check (daily, marketing_connection_check meta.*), filed as findings every beat

meta.action: Re-issue the system-user token or re-grant the page in Meta Business settings

probe.by: marketing_channels integrationWatch: the sealed token is refreshed when due; a refused refresh is the finding

google_youtube.self_fix: the access token is refreshed from the refresh token
google_youtube.action: Sign in again with the one-time connect link

google_postmaster.what: Gmail Postmaster Tools for quotesdone.com: spam rate, domain reputation, SPF/DKIM/DMARC (IT duty 'postmaster', daily)

probe.by: duty:postmaster (fn_it_postmaster_record) files duty:postmaster:unreadable:<domain> once and holds it when the token is missing or refused

google_postmaster.action: Grant the postmaster.readonly consent with the Google account that verified quotesdone.com and store the refresh token as app_secrets.google_postmaster_refresh_token

linkedin.what: the LinkedIn company page (published through Postiz; the direct API only for comments)

probe.by: the Postiz linkedin channel and marketing_connection_check linkedin.via_postiz

linkedin.action: Sign in again with the one-time connect link

tiktok_business.what: TikTok business account comments: read, answered and hidden as the QuotesDone account (publishing stays with Postiz)

probe.by: the marketing duty social_comments tiktok step: not connected is a named skip, a refused call is the duty's error

tiktok_business.action: Store the TikTok business account token and id in app_secrets (tiktok_business_token, tiktok_business_id)

code_cdns.what: modules and model files the edge functions load at boot
code_cdns.notify_why: nothing he can do about a public CDN; the finding stays with the IT engineer
code_cdns.action: Nothing to reconnect: a CDN outage passes; check https://status.esm.sh if it persists

web_search.what: the seats' web lookups while reasoning
web_search.action: Nothing to reconnect; a reasoning step answers without the web while it is down

apify.what: lead scraping (paused by the founder until about February 2027)

probe.by: nothing to probe: no code calls Apify while the founder's pause stands; the token is kept for the restart

it_reading_sources.what: sources the IT duties read domain expiry, certificates and DNS from

probe.by: duty:expiry and the sender duty report 'unavailable' when these do not answer, and never close a finding on it

mcp_servers._about: MCP servers the repository declares (.mcp.json). None is called by the running company: they are tools for the engineering sessions, so a failure stops a session, not a customer. Each is listed so a new one cannot arrive unnoticed.
mcp_servers.playwright: engineering sessions drive a headless browser with it (journey and page checks); no production code path calls it

internal_and_settings._about: Secrets and env the company mints itself or plain settings stored beside the credentials. Nothing outside answers for them, so there is nothing external to probe; internal credentials are rotated by fn_it_credential_rotate.

prefixes.cred_: an internal credential between our own functions (internal_credential)

secrets.otp_hmac_key: minted by us: signs sign-in codes
secrets.unsubscribe_signing_key: minted by us: signs unsubscribe links
secrets.unsubscribe_signing_key_legacy: minted by us: verifies old unsubscribe links
secrets.internal_credential_hmac_key: minted by us: hashes internal credentials
secrets.inbound_webhook_secret: minted by us: shared secret on our own inbound hooks
